commit_message:
Resolve the pager command once, in `_pager_contextmanager`

Follow up on #3767

reason: after 1 probe(s), probe generation failed: ProbeRefused: probe setup assigns an attribute of the imported name sys (sys.stdin = _fake_stdin); replacing part of the tree before the call records the replacement, not the code (D-235)

            _attest_value = _termui_impl._pipepager(*_termui_impl._resolve_pager_command(["definitely_not_a_real_pager_xyz123"]))
        except BaseException as _attest_error:  # noqa: BLE001 - the type is the record

                'kind': 'warning' if isinstance(_attest_error, Warning) else 'exception',
